title: Glycine Acts Through Estrogen Receptor Alpha to Mediate Estrogen Receptor Signaling, Stimulating Osteogenesis and Attenuating Adipogenesis in Ovariectomized Rats.
authors: Li, Xiaoyun; Lin, Qing; Cui, Yan; Wang, Haoyu; Wang, Panpan; Yang, Li; Ye, Qianyun; Zhang, Ronghua; Zhu, Xiaofeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘氨酸通过雌激素受体α影响骨间充质干细胞成骨/成脂分化，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: SCOPE: Glycine is commonly used as an additive in bone health supplements, the activity and differentiation of bone mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) are essential to bone metabolism, but the effect of Glycine on bone metabolism and specific mechanism are not fully clarified. METHODS AND RESULTS: The ovariectomized rats to evaluate the effects of Glycine on bone quality and quantity is constructed; then used an ER signaling inhibitor (ICI182780) and an ERalpha deficient BMSCs to explore how Glycine mediated ERalpha regulating the osteogenic and adipogenic differentiation of BMSCs; furthermore, an autodock analysis is used to assess the affinity of Glycine and ERalpha. The results show that Glycine significantly moderated bone mass and bone microstructure in ovariectomized rats; Glycine stimulates the osteogenic differentiation and attenuates the adipogenic differentiation in OVX rats and BMSCs, and these effects could be abolished by ICI 182780; further docking experiment showes that Glycine and ERalpha have a stronger affinity, and finally proves that the impact of Glycine could be blocked by ERalpha. CONCLUSION: Glycine stimulates osteogenesis and attenuates adipogenesis in ovariectomized rats, which process may involve in ERalpha mediated ER signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 范围：甘氨酸常作为骨骼健康补充剂中的添加剂，骨间充质干细胞（BMSCs）的活性和分化对骨代谢至关重要，但甘氨酸对骨代谢的影响及其具体机制尚未完全阐明。方法与结果：构建去卵巢大鼠模型以评估甘氨酸对骨质量和骨量的影响；随后使用雌激素受体信号抑制剂（ICI182780）和ERα缺陷的BMSCs，探讨甘氨酸如何通过介导ERα调控BMSCs的成骨和成脂分化；此外，采用自动对接分析评估甘氨酸与ERα的亲和力。结果显示，甘氨酸显著改善了去卵巢大鼠的骨量和骨微结构；甘氨酸促进OVX大鼠及BMSCs的成骨分化并抑制成脂分化，而这些效应可被ICI 182780消除；进一步的对接实验表明，甘氨酸与ERα具有较强亲和力，最终证明甘氨酸的作用可被ERα阻断。结论：甘氨酸在去卵巢大鼠中促进成骨并抑制成脂，该过程可能涉及ERα介导的雌激素受体信号通路。
